about.title: About VPET GO
about.description: VPET GO is a fan-made V-Pet and Tamagotchi-inspired experience focused on portable companionship, care routines, and playful progression.
about.inspiration: It draws inspiration from classic virtual pet devices while standing as its own non-commercial fan work.

updater.title: Update VPET GO
updater.description: Connect your VPET GO by USB, select its serial port, then choose Light or Full update.
updater.browserNote: Requires desktop Chrome or Edge with Web Serial support.

panel.lightDescription: Updates only the VPET GO application and keeps LittleFS data, saves, settings and content.
panel.fullDescription: Uses the official VPGo Full package: validates every component, clears NVS and LittleFS, then reinstalls bootloader, partitions, firmware and LittleFS content.
panel.fullConfirmation: Full Update reinstalls the complete VPET GO and can erase saved data. Continue?

status.idle: Select the VPET GO USB port to begin.
status.complete: Update complete. VPET GO has restarted.

errors.unsupportedBrowser: Web Serial is not available in this browser. Use desktop Chrome or Edge.
errors.wrongChip: The selected device is not a VPET GO compatible ESP32.
errors.wrongFlashSize: The selected ESP32 does not have the 16 MB flash expected by VPET GO.
errors.connectionFailed: Could not connect to the selected device. Reconnect the USB cable and try again.
errors.firmwareUnavailable: The firmware is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.
errors.updateFailed: The update did not complete. Keep the VPET GO connected and try again.
errors.invalidFirmware: The firmware package failed validation and was not installed.
